speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling on your palms; to narrow this down, have you noticed any blisters, scaling, or specific patterns on your hands? Additionally, do you have any history of joint pain or digestive issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy (numbness/tingling), and exposure to livestock (potential arsenic or infection trigger) in a middle-aged male is highly suggestive of PCT. REQUEST TEST: Serum Uroporphyrin Level, Serum Iron/Ferritin, and Hepatitis C antibody.
